coverage.name: Larimer County
limitations: Read the full official county sample ballot (all contests) and TABOR notice. Only county question is 1A: 0.3% countywide sales and use tax (up to $34.5M first year) for wildfire/drinking water/natural hazard resilience; bridges, roads, parks, trails, open space; community resilience and public safety incl. 'administration and funding of public benefits' and 'other county priorities and emerging community needs'. Excluded: not earmarked for housing/homelessness.
No participating-entities/IGA list is posted on the Larimer County 2026 Elections page (checked 2026-09-26), so not_applicable was not used.

coverage.name: Berthoud (town)
limitations: Participating (town clerk page confirms IGAs with Larimer and Weld clerks). Only town measure: Ballot Issue 3G, $28,000,000 sales and use tax revenue bonds (max repayment $60,000,000) for parks and recreation / Mountain Vista Park. Excluded: not housing.
Weld County portion of Berthoud not separately reviewed here (same town issue).

coverage.name: Estes Park (town)
limitations: Rechecked 2026-10-10: the Larimer County 2026 Elections page links the same sample ballot, described there as covering all Larimer County contests, and the same TABOR notice (tabor-notice-07-final.pdf, 24 pages). Both were re-read. Their only municipal measures are Town of Berthoud 3G and Town of Wellington 2A. The Election Legal Notice (dated 2026-09-23) lists drop boxes and VSPCs only; no participating-entities list or IGA is posted.

Town of Estes Park Elections page re-read 2026-10-10: regular municipal elections (with any local ballot questions) are held in April of even-numbered years; the 2026 election was April 7, 2026. The page states the Town is not responsible for elections coordinated with the county in November. No Town of Estes Park question is on the county sample ballot or TABOR notice.
Estes Valley Fire Protection District 6D (sales tax for fire protection) is on the ballot for Estes-area voters; it is not a town measure and not housing.
